description.value: Arwaz Hooka Lounge is a dedicated hookah bar operating under the legal entity Arwaz Hookah Lounge Limited, located in a retail building with a designated smoking area. As a sit-down lounge, it offers a place for touring cyclists to rest indoors in a relaxed social atmosphere. The OSM record notes a dedicated smoking area, reflecting its core hookah-lounge format.
